mapper.select: SELECT rc.category_id AS categoryId, MAX(r.deposit_amount) AS depositAmount FROM shop_deposit_rule r INNER JOIN shop_deposit_rule_category rc ON rc.rule_id = r.shop_deposit_rule_id WHERE r.status = 1 AND r.is_delete = 0 AND r.start_time <= #{now} AND (r.end_time = 0 OR r.end_time >= #{now}) AND FIND_IN_SET(#{merchantType}, r.merchant_types) AND FIND_IN_SET(#{shopType}, r.shop_types) AND rc.category_id IN #{id} GROUP BY rc.category_id
